snippet.title: Mr. Panas: Hilarious Multiplayer Game for Friends & Family Game Night, Add to wishlist
snippet.description:
Looking for a fun game to play with friends and family? Mr. Panas is a hilarious 3 to 5 player party game: one grumpy grandpa with a rolling pin against four invisible pests wrecking his house.

He can't see them, but with built-in proximity voice chat, he can hear exactly where they are. Ten-minute rounds, perfect for game night.

Coming soon to Steam. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5173970/Mr_Panas
